  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>

    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 0.51 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((1.0 - abs(pc * 4.0 - 2.0)) * (1.0 - colour * 0.8 + colour * 0.8 * (1.0 - abs(pm * 4.0 - 2.0))) * envA) * 0.9) * 0.7829

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, 30.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((1.0 - abs(pc * 4.0 - 2.0)) * (1.0 - colour * 0.8 + colour * 0.8 * (1.0 - abs(pm * 4.0 - 2.0))) * envA) * 0.9) * 0.7291

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>

    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, 110.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((1.0 - abs(pc * 4.0 - 2.0)) * (1.0 - colour * 0.8 + colour * 0.8 * (1.0 - abs(pm * 4.0 - 2.0))) * envA) * 0.9) * 0.8938

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.5 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, 1300.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((1.0 - abs(pc * 4.0 - 2.0)) * (1.0 - colour * 0.8 + colour * 0.8 * (1.0 - abs(pm * 4.0 - 2.0))) * envA) * 0.9) * 0.9258

dsp GenKsDrum0p3DarkTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer loop : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.9)
    set burst := burstA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(loop, length)
    let b := taplin(loop, length + 1.0)
    let avg := (a + b) * 0.5
    let flip := select(lt(noise1(fract(seed * 3.7) * 8191.0), 0.3), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    let fb := min(0.9995, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    push loop := clip(avg * flip * fb + nz * burstA, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.3 * (avg - lp) * (0.6 + colour * 0.4)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.1275

dsp GenKsDrum0p3BrightTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer loop : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.9)
    set burst := burstA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(loop, length)
    let b := taplin(loop, length + 1.0)
    let avg := (a + b) * 0.5
    let flip := select(lt(noise1(fract(seed * 3.7) * 8191.0), 0.3), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    let fb := min(0.9995, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    push loop := clip(avg * flip * fb + nz * burstA, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.8 * (avg - lp) * (0.6 + colour * 0.4)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.6136

ksDrum0p5DarkTight.source:
dsp GenKsDrum0p5DarkTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer loop : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.9)
    set burst := burstA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(loop, length)
    let b := taplin(loop, length + 1.0)
    let avg := (a + b) * 0.5
    let flip := select(lt(noise1(fract(seed * 3.7) * 8191.0), 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    let fb := min(0.9995, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    push loop := clip(avg * flip * fb + nz * burstA, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.3 * (avg - lp) * (0.6 + colour * 0.4)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.0536
